note: First published schema of protocol v1, generated from cli/src/protocol.ts as it stood on release/v1.3.0. No wire change.
Add objective tool invocation budget exhaustion and accounting fields to turn results; additive protocol v1 change.

Capability negotiation, additive, so the version stays 1. hello gains the optional fields protocol_min, protocol_max, capabilities and experimental; the new command initialize is answered by the new event initialized; error codes UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL and EXPERIMENTAL_DISABLED are added. An older client ignores the new hello fields and never sends initialize, so it sees what it saw before; a newer client that finds no range in hello falls back to the exact-version check, and one that sends initialize to an older sidecar gets BAD_REQUEST (unknown message type) and carries on without negotiation. No existing field or message changed meaning.
Clarify verifier input binding in the protocol documentation. Description-only schema change; the wire shape and meaning are unchanged, so protocol stays 1.
Add additive history tool-result metadata for complete ACP session/load replay; protocol stays 1.
Add the INFERENCE_SUBMISSION_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED turn reason and optional objective inference submission counts and history completeness; additive protocol v1 fields preserve existing meanings.
Add optional objective elapsed-time accounting fields to turn results; additive sidecar protocol v1 change preserves existing meanings.
Add the error codes UNAUTHORIZED, NOT_CONTROLLER and NOT_PERMITTED for the optional unix-socket transport (sidecar --listen); additive, protocol stays 1, and the stdio transport never sends them.

SB-1: session.state posture gains the optional string profile (the effective sandbox profile: :workspace, :read-only, :network or unconfined); additive, protocol stays 1. An older client ignores the field; a newer client that finds none from an older sidecar shows no profile.
